title: Woman Acts Weird with Cop, Serious Charges Follow
description:
On June 1st, 2022, officers conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle with a suspended registration. Inside the car, they discovered a suspicious female lying on the backseat. She wasn't ready to reveal herself and had a blanket covering her. As soon as the female got seated back up, she began searching for something in her bag. The female was handcuffed and taken to the police unit for further investigation. Here’s what the owner of the vehicle told the police. The officers found ten thousand dollars and heroin in the female's bag. The officer attempted to gather more information about the female from her husband. The husband's attitude toward the investigation heightened the officer's suspicions about the car. The police impounded the car for further investigation and released the female's husband. One of the officers helped the man leash up his dogs. The female was taken to the hospital for further processing. The female had a previous warrant and was additionally charged with trafficking controlled substances, resisting arrest and no seat belt.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
